topic: Using retirement catch-up contributions after fifty vs skipping them (Roland vs Yvette)

scenes.narration: After fifty the tax code hands you a bigger retirement allowance. Most people never claim it. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room pointing at a birthday chart where a retirement jar suddenly gets a bigger lid stamped CATCH UP, comic burst banner reads CATCH UP CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Roland and Yvette both turn fifty with two hundred thousand saved.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man roland and woman yvette blowing out FIFTY candles, each beside a jar stamped TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: At fifty, the IRS allows extra catch-up money each year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding a clipboard showing a contribution jar with an extension collar labeled CATCH UP ALLOWED AT FIFTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That extra allowance is currently about seventy five hundred dollars yearly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a measuring cup of coins stamped SEVENTY FIVE HUNDRED A YEAR beside a calendar, exam room background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Roland shrugs. He keeps contributing exactly what he always did.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man roland shrugging beside an unchanged small contribution jar, tag stamped SAME AS ALWAYS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Yvette adds the full catch-up on top of her normal contribution.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman yvette stacking an extra gold coin layer labeled CATCH UP onto her normal contribution jar, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: It costs her less than she feared. Taxes drop too.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt showing a smaller tax bill arrow labeled TAX DROPS beside woman yvette looking relieved, exam room, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fifteen years pass and both portfolios earn about seven percent yearly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a timeline arrow stamped FIFTEEN YEARS over two growth curves, each labeled SEVEN PERCENT YEARLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Yvette's catch-up money alone grew to roughly one hundred eighty eight thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman yvette beside a separate gold jar stamped ONE HUNDRED EIGHTY EIGHT THOUSAND FROM CATCH UP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That is several extra years of retirement spending for Yvette.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding a clipboard calendar with several extra retirement years shaded gold, stamped EXTRA YEARS FUNDED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Roland retires at sixty five needing to work part time.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man roland in a work apron holding a part time schedule stamped STILL WORKING AT SIXTY FIVE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Turn fifty, then turn on catch-up contributions immediately. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a clipboard reading TURN ON CATCH UP AT FIFTY, comic burst banner reads STAY HEALTHY, kids comic book illustration
